name: Low resistance liquidity run (LRLR)

definitions.definition_text: Low resistance liquidity runs taught for short-term / one-shot-one-kill: key off PD arrays based on premium or discount and look to trade from one PD array to the next (ideally discount→premium), using last ~3 months for salient institutional reference points / IPDA data ranges (20/40/60 day refs mentioned).
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Month 07 Core — Short Term Trading Low Resistance Liquidity Runs
definitions.variations_note: This lecture extract is application/framing-heavy; contrast HRLR is clearer in Month1 Liquidity Runs. Do not invent a crisp geometric LRLR definition beyond captions.
